description: This file provides Windows-specific utility functions for Kubernetes, including path normalization, named pipe endpoint creation, and retrieving system boot time.

methods.name: LocalEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs a Windows named pipe path for Kubernetes, based on a given filesystem path and filename.

methods.name: GetBootTime
methods.description: Returns the system boot time by calling Windows API 'GetTickCount64' and subtracting the uptime from current time.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Converts filesystem paths to Windows native format, replacing slashes and adding drive letter if needed.

methods.name: IsCgroup2UnifiedMode
methods.description: Indicates whether cgroup2 unified mode is enabled; always returns false on Windows.
